drawings.title: Instellarms 'Shield' Submarine — Deck Plan
drawings.description: Pressure hull with bow and stern domes, bulkhead door, and crew chairs.

drawings.title: Station Tower — Level 3
drawings.description: Modular space station tower level — offices, conference room, observation deck.

drawings.title: Venue
drawings.description: Session 10 — All That Glitters venue map. Profunda Beehive, Enceladus.

drawings.title: Hatch Fill Demo
drawings.description: Demonstrates hatch: command — solid walls, restricted zones, crosshatch, partitions.

drawings.title: The Pi Building - Second
drawings.description: General staff offices and meeting rooms. Low-priority floor for a fast team pass-through.

drawings.title: The Pi Building - Third
drawings.description: Harbor Operations & Deterrent Control. The bay-facing display wall runs the full south face. This is where the sonic deterrent buoy controls live (Appendix G) -- and where the team can see on the display that the system is dark.

drawings.title: The Pi Building - Fourth
drawings.description: Security ready room, armory, ISS liaison office, and bay-facing surveillance/comms room. Light garrison presence, not the main defense.

drawings.title: The Pi Building - Fifth
drawings.description: Governor Krein's barricade command post. His hardened comm suite and authorization codex vault (Appendix A) are here. Bay-side observation gallery gives the top floor its view.

drawings.title: Parkside Annex: Level 1 (Surface / Admin)
drawings.description: Are Old Friends Electric. Old administrative level: reception, records, offices, guard room, disused personnel airlock (west), manned cargo lock (east), central shaft landing.

drawings.title: Parkside Annex: Level 2 (The Floor)
drawings.description: Are Old Friends Electric. Gutted pilot-plant bay: conveyor beds, refit cells, gantry catwalks, 14 Line Servitors, the chip sub-station and the service shaft down.

drawings.title: Parkside Annex: Level 3 (The Vault)
drawings.description: Are Old Friends Electric. Sealed vault: shaft landing, guardian passage with ambush alcoves, vault door, containment locker, overgrown stacks and the archive chamber holding Subject 1106.

drawings.title: Parkside Annex: Level 3 Locker (5.2)
drawings.description: Are Old Friends Electric. Close-up of the vault vestibule and the sealed containment equipment locker: three racks of three stun and ion weapons, the vault door and the vault interior stub.
